title: Last Surviving Stop-Motion Puppet from a Special Effects Masterpiece

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
At the Academy's Margaret Herrick Library, Adam examines a selection of the museum's photograph collection, comprised of candid off-camera moments, publicity stills, and alternate takes for some of the most iconic images in film history. Plus, an exploration of the Academy's collection of periodical clippings chronicling the history of film props!

Learn more about the Academy Museum and its collection at https://www.academymuseum.org/ and https://www.academycollection.org/
Learn more about the Academy Library at https://www.oscars.org/library

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
